title.value: Single Allocation Hub Location with Heterogeneous Economies of Scale

title.quote: Single Allocation Hub Location with Heterogeneous Economies of Scale

extractions.description: This paper studies the single allocation hub location problem with heterogeneous economies of scale. It is a generalization of the classical single allocation hub location problem, where hub-hub connection costs are piecewise linear functions of the flow amounts. The paper models the problem as an integer non-linear program, reformulated as a mixed integer linear program (MILP) and a mixed integer quadratically constrained program (MIQCP). It employs advanced decomposition methods for solving these formulations efficiently through a combination of Lagrangian relaxation and Benders decomposition to provide solutions for both uncapacitated and capacitated instances.
